messages.subject: For Pádraig Ó Ríordáin | Corporate affairs, government relations and infrastructure growth
messages.body:
Dear CRH Corporate Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pádraig Ó Ríordáin, Chief Legal and Corporate Affairs Officer.

CRH's global infrastructure and building-materials portfolio operates across complex regulatory, community and sustainability environments. My current role is built around that same interface, with responsibility for aligning public institutions, stakeholders and operating teams around major industrial priorities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, while translating external commitments into accountable internal owners and evidence. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support CRH's corporate-affairs, government-relations, sustainability or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to CRH.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
